name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 closed near 10,346 on 20 Nov, 5.2% below its 52-week high after a weekly fall of about 4.9%
state: The FTSE 100 closed near 10,346 on 20 Nov, 5.2% below its 52-week high of about 10,911 and past the 5% Watch line (Yahoo Finance). No single-day fall in the past week exceeded 2.5%. The fall tracks the global equity sell-off that lifted the VIX to about 36 on 20 Nov; London reopens on 23 Nov.
for_you: UK share prices have fallen from their highs. Pensions and funds tracking the FTSE 100 are exposed to further swings while global volatility stays high.
why: The UK's main index — a gauge of UK-listed multinationals, pensions and sterling-area sentiment.
